Yachts For Sale

Buy a luxury yacht and experience the very best of the superyacht lifestyle, on your terms. This is yacht purchase by Velora.

Yachting. Done your way.

Yacht Purchase Made Easy

Yacht Ownership gives you the freedom to explore anywhere you want, whenever you want. A yacht is more than an asset. It can be life-changing. That's why we work on a long term basis, taking time to know you, to help you find a yacht you will enjoy for years. We leverage our in-depth market knowledge and experience brokering some of the most significant yacht sales in the world to negotiate the right price. Our team has access to thousands of yachts, both on and off market.

Yacht Advisors. Experts.

We broker yacht sales but we don't think of ourselves as sales people. We’re advisors. Experts. Passionate people, with an unrivalled understanding of the intricacies of our industry. So you can count on us to leverage our in-depth market knowledge and experience brokering some of the most significant yachts in the world to not only find your perfect yacht, but to negotiate it at the right price.

Honest Advice

Advice that adapts as the market changes. Insider knowledge on hot-to-market yachts. Guidance on when to jump at a purchase, when to jump out. And the honesty to tell which yacht is fit for purpose.

Support at Every Stage of Yacht Purchase

Support not just at the point of purchase, but before and beyond - from arranging technical inspections and offering support during sea trials, to calculating potential charter income, operating budgets or re-sale value.

Passionate Yacht Experts

Our team has sailed, lived, worked, raced on yachts across all seven continents. We love yachts. We live and breathe yachts. And we bring that energy, experience and absolute dedication to every single purchase.

Frequently Asked Questions

What are the different types of yachts for sale?

There’s a yacht for every kind of owner. Sleek performance yachts built for speed. Expedition yachts made for crossing oceans. Family cruisers designed for comfort. Sail yachts for adventure lovers. And of course, fully custom builds that turn your wildest dreams into reality. Whether you want to chase far flung horizons or drop anchor in secluded bays, we’ll find the yacht that fits your world perfectly.

What Should I look for Before Buying a Yacht?

Key considerations before buying a yacht include your preferences, intended use, and staying informed about the market. Attending yacht shows or chartering can help define your needs. Working with a knowledgable broker ensures accurate pricing and a seamless buying experience.

Learn more about yacht shows and events

How do I buy a yacht?

Speak to your Velora Broker who will advise on pricing, offering market comparisons and analysis reports. They will also arrange sea trials and inspections, supported by Velora's technical team. Your Velora Broker will collect documents and collaborate with all parties for agreement completion.

Read our guide to buying a yacht

What is the role of the broker?

A broker is your guide, strategist, and negotiator. We connect you with the right yacht, handle contracts and inspections, and safeguard your interests from start to finish. At Velora, we make the entire journey transparent, efficient, and yes, even enjoyable. You focus on the excitement of ownership; we take care of the detail, turning what can be complex into something effortless.

What are the factors to consider when buying a yacht?

Think about lifestyle first—family cruising, global exploration, or charter income. Then look at size, range, running costs, and crew requirements. Each decision shapes how you’ll enjoy life at sea. Our role is to help you balance emotion and logic, guiding you toward a yacht that feels as natural to you as your home, wherever the horizon leads.

What are the steps involved in purchasing a yacht?

It starts with understanding what you want—how you’ll use it, where you’ll go, and who’ll join you. Then comes the search, guided viewings, surveys, and sea trials. Once you’ve found “the one,” we handle negotiation, contracts, and delivery. It sounds simple, but behind every smooth handover is a world of coordination. That’s where Velora comes in.

What Happens after Offer Acceptance?

After acceptance of the offer, a sea trial and haul out will be arranged on your behalf. This allows your Velora broker, our technical experts and an independent yacht surveyor to verify that all the systems on board the vessel perform as specified.

View All Yachts Sold

Can I View the Yacht Before I Purchase?

Yes - in fact it is highly recommended to view as many yachts as possible during the purchase process. Your Velora Broker will assist in creating a shortist of yachts, organise private visits, accompany you on board and will help you ask the right questions.
